name: Salmon with Corn Salsa
steps: Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Add the salmon fillets to the pan on medium heat and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side or until cooked through.
In a separate bowl, combine the corn kernels, diced jalapeño, diced red onion, chopped cilantro, lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to make the corn salsa.
Serve the cooked salmon fillets with the corn salsa on top or on the side.
